newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares end firmer in good volume.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares end firmer in good volume.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Belgian shares end the final day of the forward market acount firmer in solid volume, though off highs as Dow Jones .DJI losses a small portion of previous session large gain.
* Bel-20 index .BFX ends 12.60 points or 0.57 percent higher at 2,209.03, with around 3.0 billion francs worth of Belgian shares traded.
* More gains seen as long as rates remain at current low levels and dollar holds up, with prospect of dividend payouts keeping prices well supported
